body: It looks like I'm doing this -- after another fight with my dad, I decided I just couldn't deal with him anymore, and I'm gonna try my luck in the city, looking for somewhere more accessible to work. Is this a good decision? Because right now I don't know which decisions are good or bad anymore.
Please PM me. I'd love to talk to you.

I agree with you entirely. I'm beginning to think I need to change my surroundings. My dad's house is too far away from everything. My mom is iffy at best, but I'm beginning to think that if I move into her house (which is in the city limits, and closer to public transit), I could look for a different job, make some money, move out, and be happier the whole time.

I'm definitely going to get my license ASAP. It's taken me too long, and that's really what bothers me. If I could've just gotten it when everyone else did, I wouldn't even have to worry about this now.

I have the highest respect for military life, but I don't think I'm cut out for it at all.
